deviations: Installed from Parity's lockfile into its own uv virtual environment, not with Unsloth's documented Colab cell (pip install sentencepiece protobuf "datasets==4.3.0" "huggingface_hub>=0.34.0" hf_transfer; pip install --no-deps unsloth_zoo bitsandbytes accelerate peft trl triton unsloth; unsloth install-kernels; pip install --no-deps --upgrade "torchao>=0.16.0"; pip install transformers==4.57.6; pip install --no-deps trl==0.22.2 (on top of Colab's preinstalled torch)). So every version is pinned (rule 7), and Colab's preinstalled torch and packages are not used.

`unsloth install-kernels` not run: it installs optional compute-kernel wheels (flash-attn, xformers, causal-conv1d, mamba-ssm; unsloth/studio/backend/utils/kernel_install.py). Parity runs no forward pass or training step, so they are off the data path being checked.

TRL 1.15.0 and transformers 5.17.0, not the notebook's trl==0.22.2 and transformers==4.57.6: this environment holds the 2026-11-23 spike's resolution of unsloth==2026.11.10 (as in the CPU run; envs/unsloth-2026.11.10/environment.json).
Python 3.12, not the documented 3.13: Parity's core requires 3.12, and the lock resolves Unsloth on 3.12.

The model is a tiny from_config Qwen3-shaped model (1 layer, random weights) saved next to the release's real tokenizer, template and config files, loaded through FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained with the notebook's load_in_4bit=True. No weights are downloaded (rule 6).
runtime_settings: UNSLOTH_DISABLE_CPU_FALLBACK=1: Unsloth raises instead of silently falling back to CPU.
UNSLOTH_DISABLE_STATISTICS=1 (the adapter also sets it): Unsloth's documented statistics opt-out.
HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN=1 and no token variables: nothing is downloaded with a login.
PYTHONPATH and other interpreter-path variables removed, so Colab's packages can't leak in.
